{{Term/Store|Satori||Series, TotK}},{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}}<ref name="Compendium">{{Cite|This noble creature watches over all animals that make their homes in the forest. Legends say this holy creature is a reincarnation of a sage that died on the lands it now protects. It has an acute awareness of its surroundings, so it seldom appears before people. It's sometimes known by its other name, Satori.|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref><ref name="Basel">{{Cite|I'm curious what that creature known as Satori is truly like? It's said to be hiding atop one of the peaks here, where a cherry-blossom tree stays in full blossom all year round.|Basel|TotK}}</ref> also known as the {{Term/Store|Lord of the Mountain||BotW}},{{Exp Game|BotW}}<ref>{{Cite|'''Lord of the Mountain'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref> is a recurring [[Creature]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.

==Characteristics==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract|Lord of the Mountain}}
The Lord of the Mountain is a [[Spirit]] that appears alongside several [[Blupee]]s on [[Satori Mountain]] on nights that it glows green.<ref name="CaC"/><ref>{{Cite|Have you heard tell of the {{Color BotW|Red|Lord of the Mountain}}? They say he appears on Satori Mountain, northwest of here...|Botrick|BotW}}</ref> On these nights, many [[Creature]]s will migrate to the Mountain, which is said to be due to the Lord calling out to them.<ref>{{Cite|The {{Color BotW|Red|Lord of the Mountain}} is said to make Satori Mountain its home... That's just ahead, before Hyrule Ridge. Animals rarely appear there, but...they say if this {{Color BotW|Red|lord}} appears, the animals will heed its call and gather. But just what in the world could it be? What is this {{Color BotW|Red|lord}} creature?!|Botrick|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Normally, few animals make their home around Satori Mountain, just ahead... But they say an appearance by the {{Color BotW|Red|Lord of the Mountain}} calls to the souls of the animals and makes them gather.|Botrick|BotW}}</ref> According to legends, it is the reincarnation of a sage that protects the lands where it died, watching over the [[Animal]]s in the forest.<ref name="Compendium"/> The Lord of the Mountain is also referred to as a guardian Spirit.<ref name="CaC"/><ref name="Compendium"/>

Due to its skittish nature, the Lord of the Mountain does not appear before people, and it will flee if it notices them.<ref name="CaC"/><ref name="Compendium"/> Using [[Stealth]], [[Link]] can approach the Lord of the Mountain and ride it. However, if he tries to take it to a [[Stable]], the owner will refuse to register it, believing it that they will be cursed if he does so.<ref>{{Cite|Wh-what is that? Can that...THING you're riding be the fabled Lord of the Mountain?! Why in Hylia's name would you bring something like that here? We'll all be cursed!|Embry|BotW}}</ref> If Link dismounts the Lord of the Mountain, it will disappear shortly after.

A [[Hylian]] traveler, [[Quince]], had an encounter with the Lord of the Mountain in the past. After hearing about the large number of Creatures that gather on Satori Mountain, Quince went there to hunt them and sell their [[Meat]].<ref>{{Cite|Have you heard that rumor about the {{Color BotW|Red|strange mountain}} on which a bunch of animals appear at a certain time? Well, when I heard that, I went there to do some hunting. I thought it sounded like a good opportunity to turn a profit, selling the meat and whatnot...|Quince|BotW}}</ref> During this visit, the Lord of the Mountain appeared and attempted to trample him.<ref>{{Cite|Later on, I doze off for a little while, and there's a big {{Color BotW|Blue|glowing beast}} standing right in front of me! It caught me completely off guard. I couldn't even draw my bow! I just stared at it. And then the {{Color BotW|Blue|beast}} runs at me like it wants to trample me!|Quince|BotW}}</ref> However, a [[Hylian Retriever]], [[Satty]], jumped in to defend Quince, which startled the Lord.<ref>{{Cite|Suddenly the pup I gave food to jumps in between us! He starts barking at the {{Color BotW|Blue|beast}}, who was ten times his size! All to...protect me... Even though he was trembling with fear...|Quince|BotW}}</ref> Quince took the opportunity to run away with Satty, the pair leaving Satori Mountain together.<ref>{{Cite|Then the {{Color BotW|Blue|beast}} recoiled a bit... So I took that chance to snatch up the pup and flee down the mountain, tripping and falling all the way... ... And that's my story.|Quince|BotW}}</ref>

The Lord of the Mountain can only be found under certain conditions on [[Satori Mountain]]. Its appearance is actually dependent on the phase of the [[Moon]], only appearing under the sixth phase, the waxing crescent. Link also must not be in the vicinity of Satori Mountain. If these conditions are met, the game selects a random hour between midnight and 10:00 PM for the Lord of the Mountain to appear, which is evidenced by the mountain being covered in a blue-green glow. The mountain will remain in this state with the Lord of the Mountain present until either 24 in-game hours have elapsed or a new day is reached twice. This state also does not persist if Link enters a [[Ancient Shrine|Shrine]] or [[Divine Beast]], or if a save is reloaded. (Merely warping across the overworld will not get rid of the Lord of the Mountain.)<ref>https://zeldamods.org/wiki/Lord_of_the_Mountain</ref>

While Satori Mountain is glowing as a result of the Lord of the Mountain's appearance, the area around the mountain and [[Rutile Lake]] will be inhabited by not only [[Blupee]]s, but many fauna that only appear at this time, including birds, woodland creatures, and insects. The fat tree surrounded by mushrooms on the south side (east of Rutile Lake) will be covered with rare beetles at night. Additionally, enemies (most notably the mountain's [[Stalnox]]) will not appear.

==={{TotK|-}}===
The guardian spirit reappears in {{TotK}}, where it is only known as '''Satori'''; the title "Lord of the Mountain" is not used. Additionally, it is sometimes referred to in the plural<ref>{{Cite|{{Color TotK|Red|Satori}} are legendary creatures that have been spotted allll over Hyrule.|Koltin|TotK}}</ref> or as "a Satori",<ref name="Konora">{{Cite|But until then, let me tell you a rumor I heard about cherry-blossom trees. Apparently there is a strange creature
called a Satori that is sometimes seen near such trees. I've never seen it myself, but I really want to...|Konora|TotK}}</ref><ref name="Kilton">{{Cite|Please. It's impossible...absurd even...to try to turn yourself into a legendary creature. A {{Color TotK|Red|Satori}} no less!|Kilton|TotK}}</ref> indicating there may be more than one– it is unclear if this is actually the case, or they are merely sightings of the same individual. [[Basel]] still refers to it as a unique being, including calling it "that creature known as Satori."<ref name="Basel"/>

At [[Cherry-Blossom Tree]]s, Link may find a bowl at the base of the tree. If he offers a fruit item in the bowl, Satori will appear and create glowing pillars of light to illuminate the locations of caves with [[Bubbulfrog]]s yet to be found, before disappearing again. [[Konora]] is often found at these trees and will remark that Satori is said to be seen at them.<ref name="Konora"/> If Link speaks to her after offering fruit to Satori, she will note that she felt an unusual sensation in the air, but seems not to have actually seen the spirit.<ref>{{Cite|That reminds me... Before, when you {{Color TotK|Red|offered fruit}} at that {{Color TotK|Red|cherry-blossom tree}} ... there was this strange feeling in the air. Like the whole atmosphere of the place changed, somehow. Such an unusual sensation...|Konora|TotK}}</ref>

[[Kilton]]'s brother [[Koltin]] has a fascination with the creature, seeking to turn himself into "a Satori",<ref name="Kilton"/> which he believes he will achieve by consuming [[Bubbul Gem]]s, claiming he read this in an "ancient text".<ref>{{Cite|And then I read these ancient texts and they told me how to transform myself— transform ME, KOLTIN— into a Satori!|Koltin|TotK}}</ref> Among the items he will trade for Bubbul Gems are the [[Mystic Set]] and [[Koltin's Fabric]], which are based after the appearance of Satori.<ref>{{Cite|Tough fabric bearing a Satori design, handmade by Koltin. It looks like it could be used to make a paraglider.|Game Screen|TotK}}</ref>

==Trivia==
* The Lord of the Mountain, the [[Giant Horse]], the [[White Horse]], and [[Patricia]] are the only individuals to get their own unique entries in the [[Hyrule Compendium]] separate from the rest of their species.
* The Lord of the Mountain is one of nine rideable [[Creature]]s in {{BotW|-}}. The other eight are the [[Horse]], the Giant Horse, the White Horse, the [[Mountain Buck]], the [[Mountain Doe]], the [[Stalhorse]], the [[Honeyvore Bear]], and the [[Grizzlemaw Bear]].
** Of these mounts, the Lord of the Mountain is is one of six that cannot be registered at a Stable.

==Nomenclature==
''[[wikipedia:Satori|Satori]]'' (literally 'knowing' or 'understanding') is a term used in Japanese and Zen Buddhism to refer to "enlightenment".

In {{TotK}}, the meaning of Satori as "enlightenment" is contrasted by the Japanese name for [[Bubbulfrog]]s, {{Romanize|マヨイ|Mayoi}}. This is the ''Katakana'' form of the word {{Romanize|迷い|Mayoi}}, which means confusion or getting lost. It is also used in Buddhism to refer to being distracted by a desire, which ultimately leads to getting lost on the way to enlightenment.
{{Nomenclature}}
